ns2:course.label: Project Design and Execution in a Physics Context
ns2:course.description: Becoming the fearless toolsmith: you will address a real-world problem with your physicist’s insight and the tools of electrical and mechanical engineers. There will be IDEs and PCBs and 3-D printers, and the remarkable experience of working collaboratively alongside fellow students and course staff. Prerequisite: PHYS 212; CS 101 or CS 124 or PHYS 246, or else extensive experience with programming a high-level computer language obtained elsewhere.
